data.content:
Thunderous drumbeats echo throughout Hong Kong. One of the most anticipated cultural events, the “Hong Kong Synergy 24 Drum Competition” proudly enters its 24th year. This spectacular showdown of rhythm and strength is a vibrant testimony to the popular outreach and legacy of the Chinese art of drumming.



As always, the orchestra issues its annual “open call” inviting drum ensembles from all backgrounds to compete, and the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza resounds in a vast sea of drums—not only for the finals of the Chinese Drumming Category for the Primary School Group and Open Group but also when other award-winning teams take their turn. Every drumbeat embodies participants’ sweat, passion and indomitable spirit, aptly reflecting Hong Kong’s unyielding drive for excellence.

data.content:
Organized by the Hong Kong Gymnastics and Dance Association, the Brilliant Cup Hong Kong Gymnastics and Dance Open Competition aims to comprehensively promote the popularity and development of gymnastics and dance in Hong Kong. By establishing a professional platform for competitive exchange, the event offers participants opportunities to observe, learn from, and compete with one another, thereby elevating overall technical standards. Simultaneously, it helps competitors gain practical stage experience and cultivate strong psychological resilience and adaptability.
To align with international standards, the program design and scoring mechanisms for the Open Division strictly adhere to international competition regulations. This initiative enables young competitors to engage with professional tournament formats early on, building a solid technical foundation to lay a firm groundwork for advancing to higher-level competitions and international stages in the future.
